_instructions: Copy this file to exp019_gates.json in the same folder and complete EVERY field yourself from the OFFICIAL Kaggle competition pages (Rules, Overview/Evaluation, Data). Only then set status to VERIFIED. Quote or name the exact section as evidence. Leave status as NOT_VERIFIED if you are unsure: the scripts refuse to run the full extraction or the analysis until this file validates. News articles and other people's repositories are not evidence.

weak_label_quality_gate._instructions: Either manual_audit_done=true with an audit_reference (a file or report in the repo), OR waived=true with a waiver_decision_id (DEC-nnn) that is actually recorded in DECISIONS.md. EXP-007 and docs/COMPETITIVE_RESEARCH_PLAN.md require a label-quality audit before report-derived labels are trained on.
